audit.why: Lane difficulty is coherent with the 51.56% win rate over 2019 games: Vladimir owns the early and mid lane through Transfusion sustain, Dr. Mundo owns the extended/late game once magic resist and Maximum Dosage regen stack. Difficulty 8/10 and carry threat 8.5/10 are left as-is.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3].text claimed you 'burst through Sanguine Pool with sheer bulk'.
audit.why: Sanguine Pool makes Vladimir untargetable for 2 seconds (Riot text). No amount of bulk lets you damage him during it. The real late-game spike is that Maximum Dosage's move speed plus regen means you are still on him, at health, when the 2s expires.
audit.corrected: See edits: spikes[3].text rewritten to outlast Pool rather than burst through it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in the matchup stated (a) that Sanguine Pool's untargetability eats your Q, E and R chase, or (b) that Vladimir's kit contains no immobilizing effect at all, so Dr. Mundo's passive cannister never fires in this 1v1.
audit.why: Dr. Mundo's passive only triggers on the first Immobilizing effect that hits him. Vladimir's P/Q/W/E/R contain slows (W, E) and damage amp (R) but no root, stun, knockup or suppression — slows are not immobilizes. So the passive cannister is jungler-only in this lane, and players who plan around a free heal are planning around nothing. Sanguine Pool at 28/25/22/19/16s is also the single punishable cooldown: rank 1 it is down 28 seconds.
audit.corrected: See edits to breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, report[11].t, whys[1], wants.you[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns listed Sanguine Pool as a flat '22s'.
audit.why: 22s is only rank 3. It is 28s at rank 1 and 16s maxed, and Vladimir rarely maxes W first — the early punish window is far larger than the page implied.
audit.corrected: Cooldown line now gives 28s at rank 1 / 16s maxed.

audit.why: Vladimir's Transfusion and Hemoplague both heal him; the _missing file flags needs-antiheal for this matchup. Grievous Wounds timing, not MR alone, decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: wants.you[0] now names Grievous Wounds alongside MR.

edits.before: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool (22s): matchup-defining — Dodges your damage. Bait it. Track it before every commit. - Your ultimate: spend it on kill windows, never on waves. - Summoners: track his Flash after any close call — it changes every dive call.

notes: Vladimir's kit has no immobilizing effect (only slows on W and E), so Dr. Mundo's passive cannister never triggers from Vladimir himself in this lane — only from a jungler or support. That is the most under-stated fact on the page and it is now in report[11].
